entries.choice: Quantize quoted USD to six decimal places using explicit ROUND_HALF_UP, including rounding exact half-microdollar values upward.
entries.scenario: A request-scoped quote computes a decimal USD value exactly halfway between two six-decimal values.
entries.gap: The design requires decimal arithmetic and six-place rounding but does not specify a tie-breaking mode.
entries.reach: All request-scoped exact-model USD quotes at a six-decimal tie boundary; ordinary non-tie values are unaffected.
entries.verdict_rationale: An explicit rounding mode is necessary for deterministic six-place results. ROUND_HALF_UP is a conventional monetary tie rule, preserves the required decimal calculation, and avoids behavior changing with the ambient Decimal context. The choice is narrowly scoped and guarded by a named boundary test. It should be documented as part of the quote contract because clients may observe the final microdollar digit.
